regime.label: Selloff, stressed
regime.summary: At 11:20 ET the S&P 500 is about -1.3% and the Nasdaq about -2.5% (QQQ -2.7%), a 7th losing day likely. VIX about 30. Gold -3.7% to about $3,549, Brent about $90.9, US 10-year 4.95%. A December Fed hike is about 95-99% priced; Fed's Cook speaks 21:15 Dubai, plus monthly options expiry.

brief: The AI chip selloff got worse into midday: Nasdaq about -2.5%, Nvidia -6%, European chips -7 to -9%, VIX about 30. Do nothing new today: no lab trade, no rocket; keep the SPYM limit at $84.26 (it should fill) and check if the Richemont CHF 170 limit filled.

todo.focus: Stressed market (VIX near 30). No lab trade, no rocket. Cancel stale limits, HOLD Nvidia.

items.text: CBRS: record the sale price so the lab log is right (Thu close $86.96)
Lab: no trade today. VIX near 30 (above 25). No rocket: Credo rejected by the red team
Saturday: read the lab weekly review and write down 1 lesson
Schneider stays WAIT: cancel the EUR 235 limit if placed (it would fill at about EUR 228)
Richemont is WAIT: CFR hit CHF 168.90, so the CHF 170 limit may have filled. If yes, log it; if not, cancel
Eaton changed to WAIT: cancel the $335 limit if it did not fill Wed

cards.name: S&P 500 ETF (SPYM)
cards.trigger: Weekly slice: BUY 6 SPYM with a limit at $84.26 (Thu close) or lower, valid to Fri Nov 27. SPYM trades about $83.16, so the order should fill.
cards.story: The 500 biggest US companies for 0.02% a year. About 9% below its high, -6.7% in a month.

cards.name: Richemont (Cartier) · Zurich
cards.trigger: WAIT. About CHF 168.90 Fri: if the CHF 170 limit filled, log it; if not, cancel. After Nov 27: BUY 2 at CHF 168 or lower only if Hermes made no new low.
cards.story: Net profit +39% while luxury peers grow 1-2%. Q2 slowed to +13%; analyst average target about CHF 210.

cards.name: Eaton
cards.trigger: WAIT. If the $335 limit filled Wed, HOLD; if not, cancel it. After the Dec 4 close: BUY 1 at $312 or that close, whichever is lower, if ETN stayed above $311.92.
cards.story: Sales +28% (organic +19%), full-year guide raised. 33% below its high after -14% in a month on AI power fears.

cards.name: Alphabet
cards.trigger: The $288 limit filled. WAIT on a second slice until the 2027 capex figure (early Feb) and search growth of at least 12%.
cards.story: Cloud sales doubled (+103%) and search still grew 12%. Fell on a profit miss partly from a one-off investment loss.

cards.name: Infineon · Xetra
cards.trigger: WAIT. No order. About EUR 45.60 Fri, below EUR 46. Reconsider only after 3 closes in a row above EUR 48.50 and no new US chip rule hits Europe.
cards.story: Guides next year +22% on data-center power chips, but the cash flow guide is below hopes. Down 7.6% Fri with European chips.

cards.name: Schneider Electric · Paris
cards.trigger: WAIT. Cancel the EUR 235 limit if placed. No new order before full-year results (late Feb 2027); then BUY 2 at EUR 224 only if a cash flow guide is given.
cards.story: Organic growth +17%, guidance raised. Fell on the PTC deal and the AI selloff; now about 2.5% above its 52-week low.

cards.name: TSMC
cards.trigger: WAIT. About $328 Fri. BUY 1 only after a close above $385, with a limit at that close or $395, whichever is lower.
cards.story: October sales +59.7%, Jan-Oct +43.3%. The drop is chip-sector mood, not TSMC news.

cards.name: Software AI fear: Salesforce, SAP
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy before Salesforce results Wed Dec 2. From Fri Dec 4: reconsider 2 CRM at or below that close if organic growth holds and no guide is cut.
cards.story: Without acquisitions Salesforce grows only about 6-7%. Cheap at about 15x next year's profit, but not yet a buy.

cards.name: UnitedHealth, Humana
cards.trigger: WATCH UNH and HUM. No buy: the rule can cut payments and its size is unknown. Reconsider after comments close (Jan 19, 2027).
cards.story: Down 10-13% on a proposed Medicare audit rule. TD Cowen upgraded both Fri, but an unsized clawback is a real risk.

cards.name: Intuit
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. Reconsider at the Mon Nov 23 close only if INTU holds above $272 and the call shows the AI hit stays in Credit Karma.
cards.story: Beat on sales (+12%) and profit, but the FY27 sales guide was cut on Credit Karma. About -10% Fri at $278.

cards.name: Luxury: LVMH, Hermes, Moncler
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy while Hermes makes new lows and LVMH Fashion & Leather shrinks. Reconsider after LVMH (late Jan) and Hermes (Feb) results.
cards.story: Hermes at a 52-week low, Moncler at a 4-year low. Part mood, but LVMH Fashion & Leather fell 5% organic in Q3.

cards.name: Credo
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy before results (Tue Dec 1, after close). Reconsider Thu Dec 3 only if revenue beats $535M and the optical target is raised.
cards.story: 65% below its high. Revenue +115% but slowing to about +97%, and four customers make most of sales.

cards.name: EU grid: Legrand, Prysmian
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy while Schneider trades within 3% of its 52-week low. Reconsider after the Fri Dec 4 close.
cards.story: Both grow double digits organically, but growth leans on data centres and deals, and Legrand Europe is -0.9%.

cards.name: European chips: STMicro, ASML
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. STMicro, ASML and ASMI: reconsider after Q4 results (late Jan 2027). Infineon: see its card.
cards.story: Down 7-9% Fri on the AI selloff. STMicro sales are fine (+17.9%), but EPS missed and capex is up about 60%.

cards.name: Siemens Energy · Xetra
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy in this selloff. Reconsider after Q1 results (Thu Feb 11, 2027) only if orders keep growing and the FY2027 guide is kept.
cards.story: Record backlog EUR 164bn and revenue guided +14-16%, but the wind unit shrinks. 38% below its high.

cards.name: Teva
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. Reconsider after Q4 results only if the 2027 guide holds Austedo near $2.5B and the profit guide is not cut again.
cards.story: Fell 8.7% Thu after its R&D chief left. Q3 revenue -2% and Austedo guided lower in 2027: mixed, not mood.
